articles.title: Apollo-backed insurer Athora weighs sale of Belgian unit, Bloomberg reports
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Athora Holding Ltd., the European life insurer backed by Apollo Global Management (NYSE:APO), is exploring a potential sale of its Belgian operations as part of a broader effort to sharpen its geographic focus, according to reporting from Bloomberg. The insurer has enlisted advisers to gauge preliminary interest from prospective buyers, though discussions remain at an early stage and management could still elect to retain the division.

articles.summary: Investing.com -- Generali (BIT:GASI) reported a 12% rise in nine-month adjusted net profit on Friday, beating analyst forecasts, although operating profit and life new business value fell slightly short of expectations and growth slowed in the third quarter.

articles.title: Generali to cut 9% of German workforce and consolidate hubs in cost drive
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Assicurazioni Generali SpA (BIT:GASI) is launching a major restructuring of its German operations, planning to cut roughly 9% of its local workforce and consolidate office locations as Italy’s largest insurer accelerates a broader efficiency drive across Europe.

articles.title: Generali (BIT:G) Stock Could Be Undervalued As Its 200% Run Continues
articles.summary: Assicurazioni Generali has produced a powerful long term share price performance, and the question now is whether that move is backed by the returns it earns on its capital. With fresh speculation around a full takeover of Banca Generali, investors are asking if the current valuation still lines up with what the group can generate from the equity it employs.
